description: This file defines an internal struct 'CoarseStopwatch' used for timing durations with a focus on low allocation and efficiency, utilizing environment tick count for timestamping.

classes.name: CoarseStopwatch
classes.description: A lightweight, non-allocating stopwatch implementation for measuring elapsed time with coarse accuracy.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new stopwatch instance with the current timestamp.

methods.name: StartNew
methods.description: Creates and starts a new stopwatch instance with a specified elapsed milliseconds.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a new stopwatch instance with a specific timestamp.

methods.name: FromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a stopped stopwatch with start and end timestamps.

methods.name: GetTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current environment tick count as a timestamp.

methods.name: GetRawTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the raw internal timestamp value.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to a stopped state with zero elapsed time.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and records the elapsed time.
